The Hardstyle Plank is not about how long you can hold the position. It's about how much tension you can generate and how effectively you can control it.
Total-body tension is a fundamental skill in bodyweight strength training. Learning to contract the right muscles at the right time allows you to create stability, transfer force efficiently, and express greater strength.
Why practice the Hardstyle Plank?
• Build powerful abdominal tension. Learn to brace your midsection and resist unwanted movement.
